lead_with.title: Biobridge Accelerator leverage
lead_with.text: Ansana was **selected for the 6‑month Biobridge Accelerator at Texas Medical Center (Oct 2026)**, giving them a foothold in the US. Gershon Consulting can translate that momentum into a full‑scale sales pipeline and partner network across the country.

lead_with.title: Data‑driven sterilization adoption
lead_with.text: Their **smart device with integrated sensors and real‑time track‑and‑trace** requires convincing US hospitals of ROI and compliance. Our LinkedIn outbound expertise connects directly with OR directors and procurement leaders who value such digital evidence.

lead_with.title: Commercial leadership support
lead_with.text: CCO **Arnoud van den Berge** brings 25 years of medical‑device commercial experience but may lack a dedicated US sales arm. Gershon Consulting can act as that arm, handling outreach, meetings, and negotiations on his behalf.

person.name: Arnoud van den berge
person.text: Arnoud van den Berge is Ansana’s Chief Commercial Officer. He has 25 years of commercial and strategic experience in medical‑device and hospital markets, with full P&L responsibility. He holds a master’s degree in engineering. No public talks or LinkedIn posts were found in the provided data.

company.text: Ansana develops **smart sterilization technology** that combines sensor‑enabled devices, real‑time location tracking, and data modules to guarantee instrument sterility, cut consumables, and lower carbon footprint. Their solution targets hospitals and surgical centers looking to improve patient safety, efficiency, and sustainability. Headquarters are in Maastricht, NL, with a US office in Delaware and active participation in the Texas Medical Center accelerator. No funding or revenue figures are publicly disclosed.

talking_points: How can we fast‑track the relationships you built through the Biobridge program into concrete sales meetings?
